# Levis Kibirie

> Levis Kibirie (Levo) is a full-stack product engineer in Nairobi, Kenya. He builds and runs production web products end to end: Next.js and TypeScript front ends, PostgreSQL back ends, payments (M-Pesa, Paystack), WhatsApp automation and AI features. He is the founder and lead engineer of Makeja Homes.

Contact: https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/contact

## Selected work

- [Makeja Homes](https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/work/makeja-homes): property management software for Kenyan landlords, with multi-tenant PostgreSQL, M-Pesa and Paystack rent collection, WhatsApp bot and AI assistant. Live: https://makejahomes.co.ke
- [Mikono Creations](https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/work/mikono-creations): a handmade crocheted-animal shop whose checkout writes the WhatsApp order. Live: https://mikonocreations.co.ke
- [Elatec Safety Systems](https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/work/elatec-safety-systems): a security and solar installer that sells and books online. Live: https://www.elatecsafetysystems.co.ke
- [Noevella Group](https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/work/noevella-group): an agency site with a CMS the founder runs herself. Live: https://noevellagroup.com
- [GhostNet](https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/work/ghostnet): a cybersecurity training platform with 13 modules, guided labs and an AI guide. Live: https://ghostnet-nine.vercel.app
- [levo-cli](https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/work/levo-cli): a terminal for exploring this portfolio, in the browser and in your own shell.
- [Hookah 3D](https://levis.makejahomes.co.ke/work/hookah-3d): a WebGL product shader experiment (in progress).
